description:
`a4SSTice-4xCO2` is part of a set of AGCM timeslice experiments (also including `piSST-pxK` and `a4SSTice`) designed to examine regional climate responses to CO2 forcing. `a4SSTice-4xCO2` can be compared with years 111-140 of `abrupt-4xCO2` to determine whether an atmosphere-only framework can adequately replicate regional climates from a coupled GCM. `a4SSTice-4xCO2` minus `a4SSTice` isolates the direct CO2 effect, including the plant physiological response. The CMIP5/CMIP6 versions of these experiments are described in [Chadwick et al. (2017)](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00382-016-3488-6) and [Webb et al. (2017)](https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-10-359-2017) but note that there have been significant changes made to the experimental protocol for CMIP7 [Ceppi et al. (2026)](https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-19-8693-2026).

`a4SSTice-4xCO2` uses monthly time-varying SST, sea-ice and atmospheric constituents from years 111-140 of each model's own `abrupt-4xCO2` run. To set up the experiment, it is recommended to start from a `a4SSTice` configuration, then to change the CO2 concentrations.
